paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: God is for us, and that settles everything. Paul says, "If God is for us, who can be against us?" (Romans 8:31). He points to the cross, where God "did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all" (Romans 8:32). If God paid THAT, He's not going to get stingy with the rest.

So what about the voices that say we're not good enough? Paul says it is God who justifies, and Christ Jesus, who died and was raised to life, is at God's right hand interceding for us (Romans 8:33-34). I used to hear that kind of voice in my own head, back when I was sitting in the dark and counting dust. The One whose opinion counts is the One who is speaking up FOR you.

And when life gets heavy, and it will, Paul doesn't pretend otherwise. He lists trouble, famine, danger and sword, and then says, "No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us" (Romans 8:37). Nothing in all creation "will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord" (Romans 8:39). So hold on to that, baker. Your hard day is real, but His love is bigger, and it's not going anywhere.
